dogecoin.text: When Dogecoin is one of the top performing coins of the day, you're gonna have a bad time.

In 2016, Apple was only comfortable approving cryptocurrency apps that contained one of these 6 cryptocurrencies: $BTC, $DOGE, $LTC, $ETH, $DAO, & $XRP (https://t.co/ubhBqMhAt6), but now they also support $BCH, $DASH, $ETC, $LSK, $XMR, $STEEM, $USDT, $WAVES, & $ZEC. Is $BAT next?
